title: France – Public relations consultancy services – Mission de conseil et de mise en oeuvre du dialogue citoyen au sein de Sète agglopôle méditerranée
description: Le maître d'ouvrage souhaite disposer d'une assistance générale à la définition et la mise en oeuvre de la concertation avec les habitants du territoire et l'animation du collectif des élus communautaires tout au long de la mandature. L'assistance portera sur la définition des stratégies, des modalités, des moyens des différentes formes de dialogues et d'animation et leurs mises en oeuvre. La première étape de la mission consistera à proposer une vision d'ensemble du déploiement d'une stratégie de concertation/animation des 4 grandes cibles du projet - les élus, l'administration, les citoyens, les acteurs sociaux-économiques. Le prestataire devra expliciter les intentions, les méthodes, les moyens, un agenda sur le moyen terme. Plusieurs outils de concertation seront mobilisables pour déployer la stratégie de concertation : l'enquête audiovisuelle, l'enquête large spectre administrée par les habitants, les réunions publiques, les ateliers techniques, la création et diffusion de contenus sur les réseaux sociaux, la création, animation et diffusion de débats au format plateau TV. Il appartiendra au prestataire de les mobiliser en fonction de la stratégie proposée. L'accord-cadre sera exécuté par l'émission de bons de commande. Les prestations sont réglées par des prix unitaires. Le montant maximum est de 800 000 euro(s) HT pour la durée de l'accord-cadre

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu, HI
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the water (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison -Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu, Hawaii. USAG-HI is considering the potential privatization of the water utility systems serving Schofield Barracks � Main Post, Wheeler Army Airfield, Schofield Barracks � East Range, Pililaau Army Recreation Center, Fort Shafter, Tripler Army Medical Center, Fort DeRussy, Helemano Military Reservation, Kahuku Training Area, Aliamanu Military Reservation, and Makua Valley Training Area. The USAG-HI water utility systems to be privatized under this solicitation may include the housing portions of the water utility systems. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor will be selected to assume ownership of the water utility system. The new owner shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. title: Netherlands – Postal services – Postdienstverlening
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Scope van de opdracht De opdracht omvat de integrale postdienstverlening voor de gemeente Breda, waaronder in ieder geval: het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van geadresseerde poststukken; het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van pakketten; het verwerken en bezorgen van verkiezingspost; het verwerken van retourzendingen; Haalservice (postbus)post en Brengservcie (postbus)post; het verzorgen van aangetekende poststukken (Binnenland en Buitenland) en overige bijzondere postdiensten; het verzorgen van kwaliteitsborging en prestatiemonitoring. De exacte omvang en inhoud van de dienstverlening zijn nader uitgewerkt in het Programma van Eisen en de SLA. Buiten de scope valt: verspreiding huis aan huis berichten (gemeentelijke berichten) en fietskoersdiensten. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één contractpartij voor het verzorgen van de postdienstverlening ten behoeve van gemeente Breda. Deze raamovereenkomst zal worden aangegaan voor een periode van 2 jaar. De ingangsdatum van deze raamovereenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze raamovereenkomst tegen dezelfde voorwaarden en condities twee (2) maal te verlengen, telkens voor de duur van één (1) jaar. De maximale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst bedraagt derhalve vier (4) jaar. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestaties van de dienstverlening. Gunning en motivatie De aanbestedende dienst gunt de opdracht aan de inschrijver op basis van het gunningscriterium laagste prijs, omdat de gevraagde dienstverlening volledig, objectief en eenduidig is gespecificeerd in het Programma van Eisen, de Service Level Agreement (SLA) en de raamovereenkomst. De vereiste kwaliteit van de dienstverlening is volledig vastgelegd in minimumeisen, prestatie-eisen, KPI's en contractvoorwaarden ten aanzien van onder meer bezorgkwaliteit, bestelkwaliteit, verkiezingspost, klachtenafhandeling, managementrapportages, continuïteit, traceerbaarheid, informatiebeveiliging en duurzaamheid. Alle inschrijvers dienen onvoorwaardelijk aan deze eisen te voldoen. De aanbestedende dienst is van oordeel dat inschrijvers zich hierdoor niet wezenlijk op kwaliteit kunnen onderscheiden zonder af te wijken van de gestelde eisen. Aanbestedende dienst is voornemens de opdracht te gunnen aan de inschrijver die een geldige inschrijving heeft ingediend en de laagste totale inschrijfprijs heeft aangeboden. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze overeenkomst wordt gesteld op € 2.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

Le futur concessionnaire sera chargé d'assurer la gestion des installations, l'amélioration et le développement de l'offre de services visant, entre autre, à conserver le classement 4 étoiles ainsi que l'obtention du label « Accueil Vélo ». Outre la gestion et l'exploitation, le concessionnaire devra assurer également la promotion du camping et de son territoire, l'entretien, la maintenance, la sécurité et la surveillance de l'équipement. En matière d'hébergements, il assurera le remplacement des hébergements locatifs actuels (hors chalets HLL) tout en répondant aux tendances actuelles du marché, ainsi que les travaux de rénovation/maintenance des chalets HLL existants. Tous les travaux immobiliers seront portés par lui dans l'objectif, notamment, de rénover l'ancien bâtiment d'accueil en logements pour saisonniers et salle de séminaire, de doter le site des installations techniques et moyens d'exploitation indispensables à la gestion de l'activité avec la création de locaux pour accueillir un atelier, des garages et des lieux de stockage en dur, sécurisés et fermés. Il devra également réaliser des travaux portant sur divers équipements : installation de bornes de recharges, aménagement d'une cuisine équipée professionnelle, renouvellement complet du mobilier de restauration, rénovation et entretien des aménagements extérieurs (aires de pique- nique et de jeu…) et aménagement paysagers. Le concessionnaire veillera, de manière générale, à l'optimisation de la gestion énergétique de l'ensemble des installations du site. Le concessionnaire collectera la taxe de séjour auprès des usagers. Il tirera sa rémunération de l'exploitation du service et assumera l'ensemble des charges résultant des missions qui lui sont confiées au titre du contrat. Il exploitera le service public à ses risques et périls sur la base d'un compte d'exploitation prévisionnel établi pour toute la durée du contrat (soit 10 ans) et annexé au futur contrat. En outre, en contrepartie de la mise à disposition des ouvrages, le Concessionnaire versera chaque année au Concédant une redevance fixe et/ou variable. Les tarifs seront fixés par l'Eurométropole de Strasbourg

title: Netherlands – Research services – Onderzoek Draadslachtoffers en Effectiviteit Hawk Eye-draadmarkeringen Verbinding Vierverlaten Ens 380 kV
description: Voor het project Verbinding Vierverlaten-Ens 380 kV (VVL-ENS380) moet er onderzoek worden uitgevoerd naar de effectiviteit van Hawk Eye (nieuwe vorm van draadmarkering, zie deze link naar artikel op TenneT website ) en actualisatie van kengetallen naar draadslachtoffers per soort. Beide zijn nodig voor de vergunningverlening voor het project, maar moeten ook TenneT-breed kunnen worden toegepast voor andere lijnenprojecten. Voor de bepaling van het aantal draadslachtoffers onder hoogspanningsverbindingen wordt momenteel gebruikgemaakt van onderzoeksgegevens uit 1987. Deze gegevens sluiten niet langer aan bij de huidige situatie en bieden onvoldoende basis om de ecologische impact van hoogspanningsinfrastructuur zorgvuldig te onderbouwen. Hierdoor ontstaat onzekerheid over de omvang van de effecten op vogelpopulaties en over de effectiviteit van eventuele mitigerende maatregelen. Het beoogde onderzoek kent daarom twee samenhangende doelstellingen. Allereerst wordt een actuele nulmeting uitgevoerd om inzicht te verkrijgen in het aantal draadslachtoffers onder en in de directe omgeving van de bestaande 220 kV-hoogspanningsverbinding tussen Vierverlaten en Ens. Vervolgens wordt de effectiviteit van mitigerende maatregelen onderzocht door deze op geselecteerde masten en geleiders toe te passen en de resultaten te monitoren. Een belangrijk onderdeel van het onderzoek betreft de beoordeling van de effectiviteit van verschillende typen vogelmarkeringen. Binnen de organisatie bestaat een voorkeur voor toepassing van de Hawk Eye-draadmarkering als mitigerende maatregel. Voor een bredere implementatie ontbreekt momenteel echter nog de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing van de effectiviteit ervan onder Nederlandse omstandigheden. Het onderzoek dient daarom de kennisbasis te leveren die nodig is om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over de inzet van deze maatregel en om de bijdrage ervan aan het verminderen van draadslachtoffers aantoonbaar te maken.

title: France – Graphic design services – Réalisation de schéma synoptiques des installations de la Direction du système d'Assainissement et du Réseau : période 2026-2030
description: Les besoins en synoptiques pour la DSAR: Le développement d'une représentation standardisée des stations locales (noeuds de gestion, stations de pompage ou de prétraitement) présente de multiples intérêts : -Faciliter la compréhension du fonctionnement des sites pour les nouveaux arrivants -Faciliter les échanges entre agents de terrain et de bureau -Limiter les risques de confusion lors de la programmation des interventions dans les réseaux -Faciliter le travail avec des intervenants extérieurs ne connaissant pas les installations Concrètement, les synoptiques répondront à plusieurs usages et notamment : -Fournir une représentation unique de chaque ouvrage, qui sera utilisée à la fois comme fond de vue Supervision, et dans les Fiches de Fonctionnement, documents en cours d'élaboration qui définiront, pour chaque station locale, son mode de fonctionnement dans toutes les situations (temps sec/ de pluie, basses eaux/ crue, mode normal/ dégradé ...) -Fournir un support de formation, pour les régulateurs du PC SAPHYRS ou d'autres agents DSAR, ou d'autres Directions -Repérage sur site à l'aide de supports placardés localement, ou réalisation de classeurs qui seront mis à disposition des agents de terrain dans les véhicules d'intervention -Illustration dans les documents et notes élaborées par la DSAR Différents types de synoptiques Différents types de synoptiques seront nécessaires pour chaque ouvrage, en fonction de sa complexité, de sa criticité, et des spécificités qu'il présente : -Synoptique 2D très simplifié pour une compréhension immédiate et globale du fonctionnement -Synoptique 2D plus élaboré pour rentrer dans certains détails -Synoptique 3D &quot; statique &quot; : des vues 3D figées sous des angles pertinents pédagogiquement -Maquette 3D : fichier informatique qui permet de regarder l'ouvrage sous différents angles, de générer des vues (coupes, plans ...) selon ses besoins -Synoptique animé : sur une vue 2D ou 3D, représentation symbolique et dynamique des écoulements pour faciliter la compréhension des ouvrages les plus complexes. Un rendu homogène L'homogénéité des rendus est importante, pour assurer une bonne compréhension de tous les intervenants, sur les Unités d'Intervention Est et Ouest, mais également en Central, pour les agents du PC SAPHYRS, de l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement, ou pour des partenaires d'autres Directions comme la Direction Technique, dont les projets sont souvent interfacés avec la DSAR. Ainsi, tous les synoptiques d'un même type (2D simplifié, 3D etc.) seront être homogènes pour tous les ouvrages représentés. Et pour chaque ouvrage, la cohérence sera cruciale entre les différents synoptiques qui apportent différents niveaux de compréhension et de détail. Le pilotage du projet Synoptiques sera assuré par l'Unité Méthodes et Ordonnancement du Service Exploitation et Maintenance de la DSAR. Le premier marché a permis d'établir la charte graphique commune à tous les synoptiques, et de réaliser les premiers synoptiques. Le travail doit se poursuivre pour traiter tous les sites de la DSAR nécessitant une représentation graphique

title: Netherlands – Articulated trucks – Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem CLAS - Matlogco - Witte Vloot
description: Bedrijfsprofiel De Aanbestedende dienst is het Materieellogistiek Commando Land (MatlogCo) van de Koninklijke Landmacht - een van de zeven onderdelen van het Ministerie van Defensie. Het MatlogCo is verantwoordelijk voor de instandhouding van het grondgebonden materieel van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie en het MatlogCo is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De hierbij gebruikte procedure is het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem uit de Aanbestedingswet 2012. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Voor deze aanbesteding volgt Defensie de Europese aanbestedingsprocedure 'Dynamisch aankoopsysteem', conform de Aanbestedingswet. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. Kort samengevat Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot het DAS houdt geen opdracht in; Het MatlogCo plaats een nadere uitvraag; Deelnemer schrijft in; Het MatlogCo beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige Inschrijving. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem Bij de publicatie in maart 2023 had het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS) een initiële looptijd van 48 maanden. Echter, aangezien deze DAS een voortzetting is van de vorige DAS met het negometrix nummer 210681, resteert er nu nog een looptijd van 35 maanden. Het is belangrijk op te merken dat de Aanbestedende Dienst de looptijd één keer kan verlengen, met een periode van 48 maanden. Het staat de Aanbestedende dienst vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd producten en/of kwalificaties toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de Aanbestedende dienst waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

description: Der DAAD schreibt die Erstellung von DAAD-Veröffentlichungen im Format Print, Online sowie Multimedia aus. Die Leistungen umfassen die Konzeption, das Projektmanagement, die Redaktion, die Gestaltung, das Lektorat, die Übersetzung und den Satz von Publikationen/Veröffentlichungen sowie die Umsetzung von Video- und Podcastproduktionsleistungen: Los 1: Redaktionelle Kommunikationsdienstleistungen Los 1 umfasst die regelmäßige Erstellung von Beiträgen (Text- und Multimedia) für das Onlinemagazin DAAD Journal, den Newsletter DAAD Aktuell und das zugehörige Projektmanagement. Zudem umfasst Los 1 die redaktionelle und gestalterische Erstellung, das Projektmanagement und die (Neu-)Konzeption des DAAD-Jahresberichts, der DAAD-Außenstellenberichte, des DWIH-Jahresberichts und von GATE-Germany Publikationen. Darüber hinaus können noch weitere Formate und Publikationen über das Los beauftragt werden. Ebenfalls Bestandteil von Los 1 sind Veröffentlichungen im Rahmen von Kampagnen und Sonderprogrammen. Dies umfasst die Formate Print (u. a. Broschüren, Flyer, Postkarten), digital/online (u. a. pdf-Broschüren/Flyer, e-paper, interaktive Broschüren), online (u. a. wissenschaftliche Online-Artikel, Redaktion von Webseiten und Grafiken, Newsletter etc.) sowie Bewegtbildformate (u. a. Videos, animierte Erklärfilme, 360-Grad-Filme, Virtual und Augmented Reality) und Podcast-Produktionen. Es handelt sich hierbei einerseits um Formate für das internationale Forschungsmarketing. Hiermit ist vorrangig - aber nicht ausschließlich - die Initiative "Research in Germany – Land of Ideas" gemeint. Andererseits handelt es sich um die Umsetzung von Veröffentlichungen von Sonderprogrammen – vorrangig, aber nicht ausschließlich – des Programms „Konrad Zuse Schools of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence“. Weiterhin Bestandteil von Los 1 sind die gestalterische und redaktionelle Erstellung des DAAD Alumnimagazins Letter inkl. Multimedia-Formaten und die Übertragung der Magazininhalte in ein bestehendes Online-Format sowie in einen Newsletter. Darüber hinaus beinhaltet Los 1 die Erstellung von Beiträgen (Text- und Video) für die weitere Alumni-Kommunikation , v.a. die Erstellung eines Newsletters für Alumni aus Deutschland. Darüber hinaus können noch weitere Formate und Publikationen der Alumni-Kommunikation über das Los beauftragt werden. Los 2: Grafik- und Design-Leistungen Los 2 umfasst die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des DAAD-Corporate Designs, die Erstellung von neuen Basislayouts und den Satz und die Befüllung von bestehenden Layouts. Dazu zählen z.B. Publikationen, Factsheets, Power-Points-Präsentationen usw. Nähere Einzelheiten hierzu entnehmen Sie bitte den Leistungsbeschreibungen für die beiden Lose, Anlage BW 2 Los 1 und Anlage BW 2 Los 2.

title: AMENDMENT No. 002: Fuel Management Cloud Software & Integration (SaaS) at North Dakota National Guard
description: AMENDMENT No. 002: Questions raised by interested Vendor with the Government Answers. NOTE: There are vendor questions that are still receiving research with pending answers by knowledgeable government personnel. There is no guarantee that any further Amendments shall be issued prior to the updated (revised) quote due date. Please submit a quote based upon the posted Performance Work Statement (PWS) along with the responses contained within these two Amendments. Any possible third Amendment will get posted not later than noon tomorrow, Friday 28AUG. If you have already submitted a quote, please feel free to revise and resubmit, if necessary, based upon this new information. Location of the six physical sites are as follows: 1. FMS 1 -- 3340 2nd ST NE, Minot, ND 58703 2. FMS 2 -- 3917 31st ST N. Fargo, ND 58102 3. FMS 3 -- 1511 48th ST S., Grand Forks, ND 58201 4. FMS 4 -- 4300 Miriam Ave, Bismarck, ND 58506 5. FMS 6 -- 2135 7th ST SE, Valley City, ND 58072 6. Camp Grafton -- 4417 Highway 20, Devils Lake, ND 58301 1. Site and equipment scope For each site, what is the approximate number of ATGs, tanks, dispensers/hoses, card readers, vehicles and users? FMS #1 (Minot): 2 Dispensers, 1 Reader FMS #2 (Fargo): 2 Dispensers, 1 Reader FMS #3 (Grand Forks): 2 Dispensers, 1 Reader FMS #4 (Bismarck): 2 Dispensers, 1 Reader FMS #6 (Valley City): 2 Dispensers, 1 Reader Camp Grafton (Devils Lake): 5 Dispensers, 3 Readers Total Scope: 15 Dispensers and 8 Card Readers across all 6 sites. Are all existing fueling systems/equipment expected to remain in service, or are any components being replaced? All existing physical fueling systems and site equipment are expected to remain in service. No physical fuel dispensers, card readers, or Automatic Tank Gauges (ATGs) are being replaced under this contract. The contractor is solely responsible for integrating and configuring their cloud-hosted software and delivering the necessary edge-networking devices/gateways at each of the six (6) locations to securely bridge our existing physical hardware to the cloud. 2. Existing equipment and systems What are the manufacturers and models of the existing ATGs, card readers, and dispensing/fueling controllers? Card Readers / Controllers: The fuel management system is a PetroVend Automated Fueling System. Dispensers: The fuel dispensers are a mix of Wayne and Gasboy Atlas models. 5. WEX / Voyager integration What specific functionality is required for the WEX/Voyager integration? The system must track WEX and Voyager card transactions to ensure accurate accounting and use-tracking. Direct billing/financial integration is not required; the requirement is solely to capture and record the transaction data. Is the expectation to support transaction authorization, card/account validation, transaction processing, reporting, or another specific function? Yes. The expectation of the system is to support all of those critical operational functions on a daily basis. 6. Site connectivity If cellular connectivity is required, is connectivity already provided at the sites, or would this be part of the project scope? No. As stated in PWS 2.3, the Contractor is responsible for providing the cellular connection and maintaining the recurring annual subscription/data costs for the secondary contingency connection. 7. SaaS, implementation, and ongoing services What SaaS subscription term is being requested? The Government for this award is only requesting a 12-month Base Period. What is the intended scope of the estimated $20,000 in government funding? For example, is this expected to cover the initial 12-month subscription, implementation, data migration, integrations, connectivity, gateways, or other project costs? The estimated $20,000 funding level is intended as a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) deliverable for the Year 1 Base Period only. This must cover all initial software licensing, data migration, required connectivity edge-gateways, and implementation. Ongoing support, maintenance, and future software licensing will be evaluated and funded as separate, recurring annual Option Years. Are there expected recurring costs for software, connectivity, support, maintenance, or other services after the initial contract period? The Government fully anticipates and has structured the solicitation to accommodate recurring annual operational costs following the initial contract period. These recurring costs will be captured and funded via subsequent multiple year awards. --------- END of AMENDMENT No. 002 --------- AMENDMENT No. 001: Questions raised by interested Vendor with the Government Answers. Q1: Can the integration and configuration work be performed remotely, or is physical presence required at the six locations? The contractor is responsible for the complete, functional integration of the edge gateways. While remote configuration of the cloud software dashboard is permitted, the contractor (or their authorized regional representative) must ensure proper physical connectivity at each of the six (6) locations. On-site NDARNG staff will coordinate facility access but will not perform hardware wiring or physical troubleshooting on behalf of the contractor. Q2: Can you confirm the estimated funding level is intended as a single fixed-price deliverable rather than an ongoing staffing or multi-year support arrangement? Confirmed. This solicitation is for a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract for Year 1 deliverables (inclusive of software licensing, cloud hosting access, edge hardware, and database migration). Ongoing support and software access in subsequent years will be structured as a new and distinct base plus Option Years requirement, subject to the availability of funds. -------- END of AMENDMENT No. 001 ----------- The North Dakota Army National Guard (NDARNG), United States Property and Fiscal Office (USPFO) has a Total Small Business Set-Aside requirement for an DX Fleet Fueling Software and Parts. Complete product description is reflected below: NDARNG currently operates physical fuel dispensing and monitoring hardware across up to six locations. The Government requires a modern, cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform to replace aging, locally hosted management software while retaining the existing physical site hardware. The small business contractor shall provide all software licensing, cloud hosting, data migration services, connectivity gateways (if required to bridge legacy hardware), and training to implement a centralized cloud-based fuel management platform: Note: This purchase order is strictly for software, data migration, and connectivity; no physical fuel dispensers, ATGs, or island terminals will be replaced under this PWS. title: Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) Containerized Launcher (CL) and Remote Interceptor Guidance 360 Degrees (RIG-360) Containerized System (CS) Phase 2 Program
description: This award is for the incremental design, build, and test of the following major end items (MEIs): MSE CL Increment 1 (MSE CL INC 1), to include providing engineering and testing assets to support performance of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) testing using Lockheed Martin and Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Fires facilities, conducting a Design Maturity Review (DMR), and establishing the preliminary hardware and software baseline; MSE CL Increment 2 (MSE CL INC 2), to include providing engineering and test assets to support environment qualification testing, address deviations and substantiating fixes from MSL CL INC 1, and performing failure mode and criticality analysis and electronic parts / circuit tolerance analysis; MSE CL Increment 3 (MSE CL INC 3), to include providing engineering and test assets to support live-fire flight test events, conducting pre-flight checkouts, walk-ups, and test missile loading; MSE CL Increment 4 (MSE CL INC 4), to include providing engineering and test assets to support first article inspection, and validation of assembly processes and testing processes; MSE CL Increment 5 (MSE CL INC 5); RIG-360 CS Increment 1 (RIG-360 CS INC 1); RIG-360 CS Increment 2 (RIG-360 CS INC 2); RIG-360 CS Increment 3 (RIG-360 CS INC 3). MSE CL is an air defense launcher capable of transporting, raising, firing Phased Array Tracking to Intercept On Target (PATRIOT) Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3) MSE munitions and operating as a componentized weapon in the Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) architecture utilizing existing PAC-3 MSE launcher electronics. MSE CL scope for this requirement includes performing incremental design, development, and test improvements of MSE CL, including propriety software redesign on MSE Missile, Launcher Electronics, and Fire Control, and establishing hardware/software baselines for each increment. RIG-360 is an interceptor datalink device, which integrates with IBCS through an Integrated Fire Control Network (IFCN) Relay, and communicates with any PAC-3 MSE interceptor within its communication range. RIG-360 CS scope for this requirement includes performing updated design, development, and testing of a RIG-360 CS of prototype pedigree. In addition, the contractor shall support flight test execution for demonstrating the MSE CL and RIG-360 CS, including all HWIL, walk-ups, and post-mission debriefing and data analysis. Award was made to Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (LMMFC), 1701 West Marshall Drive, Grand Prairie, Texas 75051, commercial and government entity (CAGE) code 64059. In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 6.302-1(a)(2)(iii)(A) and (B), Due to the proprietary nature of the PAC-3 MSE missile and Launcher Electronics data processing LMMFC is the only source with knowledge, expertise, and full disclosure technical data package (TDP) to perform this effort. The Government does not have the necessary intellectual property rights to utilize the data for full and open competition. Contract Award Number: W31P4Q-22-G-0003 / W31P4Q-26-F-0114 Contract Award Dollar Amount (Not-to-Exceed (NTE)): $347,500,000 Contracting Officer (KO) Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal (ACC-RSA) CCAM-MSA-B

title: AFREP Modular Electronic Repair Workbench Systems
description: This an official Solicitation posted in accordance with RFO Part 5.201. The Department of the Air Force intends to procure four (4) specialized, heavy-duty modular electronic repair workbench systems. This turnkey requirement includes vendor-provided shipping, delivery, and on-site installation at Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany. This requirement is being executed as a "Brand Name or Equal" acquisition (Target Brand: LISTA) to meet stringent operational, safety, and spatial tolerances within the existing facility. We highly encourage and welcome submissions from vendors offering alternate "equal" solutions. To be considered technically acceptable, offerors proposing an "equal" product must demonstrate that their proposed solution meets or exceeds the physical, functional, and performance requirements outlined in the attached Salient Characteristics document. While aesthetic equivalents are acceptable where noted, the Government must adhere strictly to the core physical parameters established in the salient characteristics�specifically dimensions, weight capacity, electronic access control, and ESD/power management. Strict adherence to these minimum thresholds is mandatory to prevent critical operational disruptions, safety hazards, and facility layout impacts. At this time, the Government is conducting market research to gauge industry capability and interest. Interested vendors who can provide the LISTA brand or a technically equivalent product that meets the attached Salient Characteristics are requested to submit a brief Capability Statement. Submissions should clearly address the vendor's ability to meet the dimensional tolerances, load capacities, and electronic drawer access requirements.

title: Q701--Radiation Oncology Quality Surveillance (VHA-ROQS) Program
description: 1. Description The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veteran Health Administration (VHA), intends to issue a solicitation for contractor support to sustain and enhance the Radiation Oncology Quality Surveillance (VHA ROQS) Program. The contractor will evaluate, update, and maintain evidence based clinical quality measures (CQMs) used to monitor and improve radiotherapy quality across VHA radiation oncology practices nationwide This acquisition supports ongoing development of CQMs, SME driven updates, decision tree logic validation, and continuous quality improvement activities. 2. Scope of Work The contractor shall provide services including but not limited to: Evaluating existing CQM measure sets and prioritizing updates based on current evidence, performance data, and national guidelines. Convening Subject Matter Expert (SME) panels to define, revise, and validate CQMs. Developing and updating scoring logic, clinical/dosimetry data elements, and decision trees used to determine Pass/Fail/Exclusion scoring. Ensuring decision tree applicability across all 41 VHA radiation oncology services and communicating any exceptions in writing. Providing ongoing stakeholder support, including monthly calls with the NROP office and structured communication with the COR. Delivering a detailed project timeline outlining tasks, milestones, and deliverables 3. Performance Objectives The contractor will: Evaluate and revise each measure set at least once every two years. Develop or update two measure sets annually. Establish expected performance rates for each CQM. Validate logic models and ensure alignment with current literature, consensus practices, and anticipated standards of care. Support VHA s quality surveillance program without influencing or formulating VHA policy (policy decisions remain solely within VHA) 4. Security Requirements Certification & Accreditation (C&A) requirements do not apply. A Security Accreditation Package is not required 5. Procurement Status This requirement is unrestricted at the pre solicitation stage. The VA will determine set aside status following completion of market research. 6. Solicitation Availability The solicitation will be posted to SAM.gov on or about: July 30,2026 No solicitation is currently available. No telephone inquiries will be accepted. 7. Point of Contact Contracting Office: Department of Veterans Affairs Email: Cassie.white@va.gov Additional Instructions: All future updates, Q&A, and amendments will be posted to SAM.gov only.

Special Notice: Brand Name Haworth Furniture Solicitation Number: FA8601-26-Q-0111 Notice Type: Special (RFQ) Issuing Office: AFLCMC/PZIBA Posted Date: July 28, 2026 Response Date: August 31, 2026, 11:00 AM EDT Set-Aside: N/A Classification Code (PSC): 7110 NAICS Code: 337214 Small Business Size Standard: 1,100 Employees Description: The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC/PZIBA), on behalf of Department of the Air Force at Wright Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB), intends to award a Brand Name Only, firm-fixed-price contract for Haworth Furniture. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products prepared in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through the RFO (effective April 17, 2026) and the Revolutionary Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (RDFARS) as of the date of issuance. The Department of the Air Force intends to award a firm-fixed-price contract for Haworth Furniture in accordance with the attached Statement of Work (SOW), on a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) basis. The Schedule of Supplies, place of performance, delivery information, and the full list of applicable provisions and clauses are set forth in the attached SF 1449 and solicitation. Award is subject to the availability of funds. The requirement is for all supplies, labor, and services necessary to complete the furniture requirement of WBAFB. This is a follow-on project that requires new workstations to be physically compatible and fully interchangeable with the existing Haworth furniture. The Government's market research indicates that Haworth products utilize proprietary physical connections, and no other manufacturer produces a compatible system that can meet the Government's essential need for a single, integrated, and reconfigurable workspace. In accordance with the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul, (RFO) 5.101(c)(4)(vii), the justification for restricting competition is that the proprietary Haworth physical connections and design are essential to the Government's requirement, and no other brand of systems furniture can interface with the existing setup. Therefore, this acquisition is being conducted under the authority of (RFO) 6.103-1. This is a BRAND NAME ONLY requirement. Only brand name Haworth products will be accepted. "Or Equal" products will NOT be evaluated. Standardization of Haworth is required to ensure compatibility with existing systems, eliminate duplication of training costs and maintain mission continuity. In accordance with RFO 5.201(c)(3), the approved Brand Name Justification and Approval (J&A) is attached to this posting on SAM.gov. title: Port Everglades Harbor Maintenance Dredging Broward County, Florida
description: DESCRIPTION OF WORK: The project work consists of maintenance dredging of shoal material from the Federal navigation channel and Port Everglades berthing areas and will be divided into a Base (Federal) and Option A (non-Federal). This project incorporates 2 feet of allowable overdepth and dredged material will be disposed of in the Port Everglades Ocean Dredge Material Disposal Site (ODMDS). Additional work includes, but is not limited to, construction vibration monitoring, endangered species monitoring, turbidity monitoring, and maintenance of traffic. Option A: The project work includes dredging of Local Sponsor Port Berths 1 through 5, 7 through 10, 12 through 15, 26 and 27, 30A and 30G. Option A work also includes environmental and water quality monitoring. The Invitation for Bid (IFB) will be issued on or about 31 July 2026 and bids will be due on or about 31 August 2026.NAICS Code 237990, Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities. The Small Business Standard is $37 million. The Target Price Range is between $5,000,000.00 and $10,000,000.00.The period of performance associated with this requirement is: 125 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). The contractor shall commence work within 60 calendar days of receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP).NOTE: Notice to Proceed (NTP) will be issued between 75 and 90 calendar days after award or after all required bonds are in place, which is later. Base: 110 calendar days. Option A: 15 calendar days. THIS PROCUREMENT IS AN UNRESTRICTED REQUIREMENT.NOTE: COAST GUARD CERTIFIED DREDGE VESSELS ARE REQUIRED FOR THIS PROJECT. title: Y1PZ--823-NSP25-003 National Shrine Project at Wood National Cemetery
description: Solicitation Number: 36C78626B0032 Project Number: 823-NSP25-003 Description: National Shrine Project at Wood National Cemetery This notice is provided for information purposes only and does not constitute a request for Bid, Proposal, or Quote. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Cemetery Administration (NCA) intends to issue solicitation number 36C78626B0032 entitled, National Shrine Project at Alton National Cemetery on or about September 15, 2026, unless additional notice is given, or this notice is modified or cancelled. Scope of Work: The Contractor must provide all personnel, management, supplies, transportation, equipment and supervision necessary to perform and complete all work to provide complete section renovation for the cemetery sections indicated that includes, but not limited to: site surveying; preparing grading plans and headstone realignment plans; vegetation removal, grading and drainage, excavation and backfill; headstone identification/tagging; headstone handling; flat marker geogrid support system; headstone re-installation; headstone cleaning; turf renovation; and site restoration work. Note: Headstone includes both upright headstones and flat markers. All services performed by the contractor must adhere to National Cemetery Administration standards. Period of Performance The Contractor shall complete all work including submittals, reviews, quality control, repair/construction services, punch list corrections, clean up, invoicing and closeouts documentation submittal within Three Hundred and Sixty-Five (365) calendar days from Government issuance of the Notice to Proceed. Note: The effective period of Turf Renovation component of the project shall occur between April 15 to June 30 for spring, and from August 15 to October 15 for fall of awarded period of performance. Turf must be established prior to the onset of winter season. Bare ground is not acceptable during this time. Place of Performance Department of Veterans Affairs National Cemetery Administration Wood National Cemetery 1301, 5000 W National Avenue Milwaukee, WI 53295-0004. The Product Service Code (PSC) for this procurement is Y1PZ - Construction of Other Non-building Facilities. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement 238910 Site Preparation Contractors, and the business size standard is $19.0 Million. The magnitude of construction for this project is Between $500,000 and $1,000,000 per FAR 36.204. The full Solicitation, Specifications, Drawings and related documents will be posted on Contract Opportunities on or about September 15, 2026, unless additional notice is given, or this notice is modified or cancelled at SAM.gov. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation. This procurement is 100% Set-Aside for Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) concerns. Only verified VOSB firms are eligible to submit an offer or receive an award of a VA contract that is set aside for VOSB in accordance with VAAR Part 819. A non-verified vendor that submits a bid or proposal will be rejected as non-responsive. Offers received from concerns that are not Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) concerns shall not be considered. (See VAAR Clause 852.219-74 VA Notice of Total Set-Aside for Verified Veteran-Owned Small Businesses. Set-Aside.) To be eligible for award, the VOSB must be considered small under the relevant NAICS code and must be registered and verified in the following websites: those desiring to receive an award from this solicitation must be registered at https://search.certifications.sba.gov/. Companies must have the Certified Veteran Enterprise (CVE) seal on their registration to be considered for an award. The SBA database https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ will be checked both upon receipt of an offer and prior to award; firms must be currently registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at www.SAM.gov and have completed online Representations and Certifications prior to contract award. In accordance with VAAR 819.7003(b), at the time of submission of bids, and prior to award of any contracts, the offeror must represent to the Contracting Officer that it is (1) VOSB eligible under VAAR Subpart 819.70; (2) Small business concern under the NAICS code assigned to this acquisition; and (3) VOSB listed as verified in SBA database at https://search.certifications.sba.gov/. Interested bidders will be required to furnish a Bid Bond; and the awarded Contractor will be required to provide Performance and Payment Bonds if required. description: SPECIFIC PROCUREMENT NOTICE (SPN) Country: Belize Project Name: Education Project Procurement Title: TVET Technical Support Consultancy Procurement Ref. Number: MCA-B/EDU/QCBS/26/3008 Type of Procurement (goods, works or services as applicable): Consultant Services Accountable Entity: Millennium Challenge Account - Belize (MCA-Belize) Publication Date: 20 July 2026 Submission Deadline: No later than 14:00 hours (local time in Belize) on 31 August 2026. The Accountable Entity, MCA-Belize, has received financing from the Millennium Challenge Corporation toward the cost of the Education Project, which aims to equitably increase the number of post-primary graduates with the competencies relevant to labor market demand, and the Energy Project, which aims to lower the wholesale cost of electricity in real terms, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Technical Support Consultancy. MCC�s funding is appropriated by the U.S. Congress and obligated to the compact up-front, with no incremental or partial funding. So, when a contract is signed with an Accountable Entity, money is already available to the Accountable Entity and, for most contracts, invoices are paid directly to Offerors by the US Treasury. MCA-Belize now invites offers from eligible offerors for TVET Technical Support Consultancy. The overall objective of this consultancy is to support MCA-Belize and the Government of Belize in designing and implementing the Training and Transitioning to Work Activity under the Belize Compact, with the aim of strengthening the governance, quality, and labour-market relevance of the TVET system and improving the transition of learners from training into employment. The consultancy will support the establishment and operationalization of the NTA as the national body responsible for coordinating, establishing standards, and assuring the quality and relevance of TVET programmes across Belize. The assignment will also support the development of mechanisms that strengthen industry engagement, improve the capacity of training providers, and expand opportunities for work-based learning and employment pathways for TVET graduates. Bidding will be conducted through the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) procedures as specified in the Accountable Entity MCC Procurement and Policy Guidelines (PPG) and is open to all eligible offerors as defined in the PPG. title: J065--DIGITIZERS: VIDEO: MEDICAL NX EER 274060 | SEPG 516356
description: This is a SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. It is neither a solicitation announcement nor a request for proposals or quotes and does not obligate the Government to award a contract. Requests for a solicitation will not receive a response. Responses to this sources sought must be in writing. The purpose of this sources sought announcement is for market research to make appropriate acquisition decisions and to gain knowledge of potential qualified Small Businesses interested and capable of providing the services described below. The priority is to find two or more Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB), Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (VOSB). Documentation of technical expertise must be presented in sufficient detail for the Government to determine that your company possesses the necessary functional area expertise and experience to compete for this acquisition. Responses to this notice shall include the following: (a) company name (b) address (c) point of contact (d) phone, fax, and email (e) DUNS number (f) Cage Code (g) Tax ID Number and (h) must provide a capability statement that addresses the organizations qualifications and ability to perform as a contractor for the work described below. CONTRACT REQUIREMENTS GENERAL: VA San Diego Audiology and Speech Pathology is replacing the following outdated equipment: TIMS 2000 SP recommended life cycle expiration date as determined by the Biomedical Department. Audiology and Speech Pathology has a requirement for one TIMS 200 SP for the La Jolla Clinic. BACKGROUND: The VA San Diego Audiology and Speech Pathology Service has a requirement for a TIMS 2000 SP. PURPOSE: The TIMS 2000 System is a PC based video recording device that connects to any fluoroscope. TIMS records high-resolution / high-frame rate video with synchronized audio, and automatically converts the study to DICOM format for archival to any PACS or VNA. SCOPE: VA San Diego Audiology and Speech Pathology Service is requesting contractors to provide brand name or equal equipment that meets or exceed the physical, functional, and performance of the listed salient characteristics in this section. The equipment feature is essential to the technical requirements to meet the needs of the department. PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS: Equipment must have the physical characteristics to enable the government to perform the capabilities. Standardization is the rationale for staying with e3 Diagnostics TIMS 2000 SP, GOV TIMS Trade-In Discount COMMENTS: Pricing includes the trade in of your current TIMS system for a discount of $5000 per system Pricing includes a new monitor Pricing includes new connections for one modality Pricing includes on-site Installation and Training TIMS System Prices Include a LCD Monitor, a one-year license renewal of the existing TIMS Review software license, and Typical Onsite Installation and Training. TIMS Installation and Training: Includes installation on one modality over approximately 1.5 days in one visit Each additional modality is $3,995. Consult sales for part numbers Modality & modality room must be unused at scheduled install time Up to 4 Hours of On-Site Installation at one location Up to 4 Hours of User Training at one location Valid for US and Canada only. Consult sales for installation in other countries. TIMS Trade-In TIMS Support & Maintenance

title: Germany – Research and experimental development services – Toolkit für aktives Verteilnetzmanagement
description: Ziel dieses PCP ist die Entwicklung eines Prototyps eines skalierbaren digitalen Werkzeugkastens für das aktive Management von Niederspannungsnetzen, der im Feld bei Netzbetreibern unter realen Bedingungen getestet wird (TRL 7). Unter diesem Werkzeugkasten wird eine modulare, offen gestaltete Lösungsumgebung verstanden, die wesentliche digitale Werkzeuge für den Netzbetrieb bereitstellt und die spätere Einbindung weiterer Werkzeuge verschiedener Anbieter über offen definierte Schnittstellen ermöglicht. Insbesondere soll die Lösung das Problem fehlender rechenfähiger Netzmodelle als Voraussetzung für die Werkzeuge behandeln. Dabei soll auf innovative Methoden zurückgegriffen und aktuelle regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen in Deutschland und der EU berücksichtigt werden. Eine Marktkonsultation zum PCP wurde am 27.02.2026 mit einer Prior Information Notice (PIN) auf der offiziellen EU-Plattform Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) mit einem Link zur begleitenden Online-Umfrage gestartet. Weiterhin wurde die Information auf der Webseite energieforschung.de, auf LinkedIn und im Intranet der Forschungsnetzwerke Stromnetze geteilt. Darüber hinaus wurden marktführende Unternehmen im Bereich aktives Verteilnetzmanagement, Expertinnen und Experten aus der Forschung und Vertreter von Verteilnetzbetreibern (VNBs) interviewt. Im Zuge dessen wurde eine State-of-the-Art-Analyse (SOTA-Analyse) der aktuellen Lösungen auf dem Markt durchgeführt. Zur Sicherstellung transparenter und gleicher Wettbewerbsbedingungen für alle interessierten Unternehmen ist ein Bericht mit den Ergebnissen der Marktkonsultation Bestandteil der Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Die Teilnahme an der Marktkonsultation ist keine Voraussetzung für die Teilnahme am PCP. Das PCP ist Teil der Transferoffensive Energieinnovationen (Titel 6093 893 51 des Wirtschaftsplanes des Sondervermögens Infrastruktur und Klimaneutralität) und baut auf vorangegangenen Forschungs- und Innovationsaktivitäten auf, indem es deren Ergebnisse in Richtung systemrelevanter Anwendungskontexte weiterentwickelt. Alle Dokumente und Informationen können unter folgender Website abgerufen werden: https://www.energieforschung.de/de/foerderung/foerderangebote/vorkommerzielle-auftragsvergabe-toolkit-aktives-verteilnetzmanagement

title: Multichannel Pyrometer
description: NOTICE OF INTENT This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. NAVSUP FLCSD intends to award a sole-source contract. The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center San Diego (FLCSD) intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price (FFP) contract on a sole-source basis to FAR Associates (CAGE: 1TUU1, POC Email: raffar@pyrometry.com), 8877 Freeway Drive, Macedonia, OH, using the procedures in FAR part 12.201-1. The statutory authority for this noncompetitive action is FAR 12.102(a), Only one source is available, pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901. NAVSUP FLCSD intends to use simplified commercial acquisition procedures applicable to this requirement. The Government�s requirement is for a high-precision multichannel pyrometer system capable of supporting advanced modeling of laser/material interactions for direct energy research. Specifically, the system must be capable of real-time absorption (off-gas) compensation. During high-energy laser testing, targeted materials vaporize and create severe off gassing, which distorts thermal readings. The required system must compensate for this vaporized material interference while simultaneously providing continuous, wavelength-dependent emissivity measurements in extreme heat ranges (300�2000� Celsius). Standard pyrometers are unsuitable due to off-gassing interference and lack of these specific capabilities. The NAICS code for this procurement is 334513 (Instruments and Related Products for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables). The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6650. The anticipated award date is on or before September 15, 2026. This notice is issued solely for market research and to determine whether other responsible sources can meet the Government�s minimum requirements. Interested parties may submit their documentation demonstrating the ability to provide equipment that meets the Government�s minimum requirement. Equipment Minimum Requirements Submissions must demonstrate that the proposed equipment possesses the minimum required capabilities described above (specifically, real-time absorption/off-gas compensation and continuous, wavelength-dependent emissivity measurements from 300�2000� Celsius). This market research is solely to determine if technical capabilities exist in the marketplace. Submission Instruction Length Constraint: Submissions must not exceed 6 pages (10-point, Times New Roman font). Review Process: The results of this assessment will help the Government determine whether there are qualified sources and inform the decision on whether to continue with sole-source procurement or pursue competition. Requests for information or submissions with only questions are not affirmative responses. description: L'ADEME souhaite disposer d'une solution intégrée pour la gestion complète de ses formations multimodales, incluant une vitrine ADEME Académie, la gestion administrative, le pilotage logistique, la diffusion des formations en ligne, ainsi que l'interopérabilité avec les outils institutionnels. title: 355 CMS Fuel Compressors Maintenance
description: The 355 Contracting Squadron is requesting a long term service contract to maintain and repair Quincy Air Compressors (See attached PWS for Models). This compressor is essential for daily squadron operations, including vehicle maintenance and repairs for two Quincy air compressors and a desiccant air dryer at Davis-Monthan AFB. These systems supply vital breathing and shop air for the 355th Component Maintenance Squadron (355 CMS). The contractor shall inspect and perform preventive maintenance, as recommended by the manufacturer, on the Quincy air compressors and desiccant air dryer. At a minimum, this includes changing filters and separators, changing oil, inspecting and servicing valves and controls, taking oil samples, verifying proper operation of safety devices, and conducting operational checks of the compressors and dryer. The contractor shall ensure the system operates properly and safely while minimizing disruptions and inconveniences to users until the next scheduled maintenance. Repairs made during scheduled preventive maintenance are considered any repairs consistent with normal wear and tear of compressor and dryer operation. If the contractor identifies conditions that require work beyond normal preventive maintenance, the contractor shall treat that work as non-routine maintenance and proceed in accordance with the PWS.

description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation and quotes are being requested. Request for Quote Number W912HZ26QA045 is being issued as a request for quote (RFQ) with intent to award as a single contract. The solicitation document and incorporated provision and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2024-05. This requirement is 100% set-aside for small business under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 334513 with a Small Business Size Standard of 750 employees. This procurement is being conducted in accordance with regulation at RFO FAR 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items and RFO FAR Part 13, Simplified Acquisition Procedures. The US Army Corps of Engineers, Engineer Research and Development Center (ERDC) 3909 Halls Ferry Road, Vicksburg MS 39180-6199 has a requirement for Dominica Equipment Procurement and Delivery acquisition. The contractor shall refer to the Description of Requirement attachment. Please see attached for complete requirement. BASIS FOR AWARD The Government intends to award one contract to the responsible offeror whose quote is responsive to the solicitation and determined to be the best value and most advantageous to the Government. Each quote will be evaluated for technical acceptability, delivery lead time and price. In our evaluation offers with a shorter lead time may be evaluated more favorably. The Government intends to evaluate offers and award a contract without discussions with offerors. Therefore, the offeror�s initial offer should contain the offeror�s best terms from a price and technical standpoint. However, the Government reserves the right to conduct discussions if determined by the Contracting Officer to be necessary. The Government may reject any or all offers if such action is in the public interest. INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS (REFERENCE FAR RFO 52.212-1) Pursuant to RFO FAR 52.204-7(b), System for Award Management, offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time an offer or quotation is submitted. It is the offerer�s responsibility to provide the Government with enough information to evaluate the submitted proposal to include a technical description of the items being offered in sufficient detail to evaluate compliance with the requirements in the solicitation. This includes providing the terms of any standard warranty and technical support. Equipment specifications or other descriptions are highly encouraged. Delivery lead time must be provided. All quotes shall be provided in months and include all costs including delivery. Offerors are responsible for submitting offers, and any modifications, revisions, or withdrawals, so as to reach the designated government emails by the date and time designated in the solicitation. Any solutions that meet the minimum requirements will be considered. Quotes are due September 2nd, 2026, 12:00 PM (Central Daylight Time): Quotes must be provided in accordance with RFO FAR 52.212-1. Quotes will be accepted by email only to: trineciya.c.winford@usace.army.mil and must include the solicitation number in the subject. For information concerning this solicitation contact Tri�Neciya Winford via email at the above email address. Offerors should check the www.SAM.gov website often for any information regarding this solicitation and/or amendments to this solicitation. EVALUATION RFO FAR 52.212-2 - Evaluation -- Commercial Items: (a) The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government. The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: 1) Technical acceptability 2) Price The Government will issue an award to the offeror whose quote is the Lowest Price that is determined to meet at least the minimum requirements to be determined Technically Capable. (1) Technically acceptability is defined as the documented capability to meet the minimum requirements of the project as specified in this solicitation and the attached specifications, including evidence of the offeror's capability to provide the items specified and the ability to meet or exceed the specified delivery schedule. It is imperative that the offeror submit sufficient documentation and information for the Government to determine technical capability and quoted price. Failure to submit sufficient information for the Government to determine technical capability and quoted price may be cause for rejection of your quote. (b) A written notice of award or acceptance of an offer, mailed or otherwise furnished to the successful offeror within the time for acceptance specified in the offer, shall result in a binding contract without further action by either party. Before the offer's specified expiration time, the Government may accept an offer (or part of an offer), whether or not there are negotiations after its receipt, unless a written notice of withdrawal is received before award. title: Digital exhibition design, software development and production for the reopening exhibition for the National Museum of Finland.
description: Digital exhibition design, software development and production for the reopening exhibition for the National Museum of Finland. The Finnish Heritage Agency, the Exhibitions and Events department of the National Museum of Finland (hereinafter the “Procurement unit”) invites suppliers to submit tenders for media design and production (hereinafter the “Service”) in this call for tenders and its attached annexes. The Service consists of programming, project management and technical delivery of an artificial iIntelligence System in the form of an interactive media software which will be used according to attached plans. The entire deliverable procurement is referred to in hereinafter as the "System". The National Museum of Finland will conduct the procurement through an open tendering procedure. The aim is for production to begin immediately after the selection of the supplier in approximately September 2026, and for delivery to the Procurement Unit to be completed no later than January 2027. The procurement documents are available in English. The Procurement unit requests a tender for: 1. Exhibition Media, AV and Interactive Elements including: - Lobby Screen - Intro to the Universe (projection) - Chatty objects - 9 interactive conversational artificial intelligence stations: - Chatty Objects Birds - Chatty Object Scarab - Chatty Object Meteorite - Chatty Object Shiva - Chatty Object Canoe - Chatty Object Turtle Seats - Chatty Object Raven Mask - Chatty Object Chilkat Blanket - Chatty Object Bad Luck Bird - Chatty Object Scarab - Projection (Hybrid element) - Agnicayana film projection solution -Exhibition wide - soundscapes including: - Anvil & hammer - Chatty Objects Birds - Audio - Egg - Chatty Object Meteorite - (hybrid element) - Chatty Object Canoe - (hybrid element) - Chatty Object Raven Mask - (hybrid element) - World tree - Conch - Universe - Overhead Screen - Universe - Chatty Universe The following items are not included within this tender: - Film content for the Agnicayana film projection - Recording of poem for the Egg Soundscape 2. Software, Services and Project Management including: - Software development and testing - Software installation and configuration - Technical and user documentation - Support and on-call services during the exhibtion run - Training for the client's staff in the operation of the delivered systems - Project management covering the entire Procurement 3. Documentation set: - Technical documentation (architecture, APIs, content formats, deployment instructions). - Operational documentation for daily use by exhibition staff. - Maintenance instructions, including restart procedures and troubleshooting steps. - Documentation required under the attached Annex 3 "03_Data and privacy requirements annex". - The tenderer shall provide sufficient documentation to enable re-installation and re-use of the System by the Procurement unit without dependency on the tenderer if the Procurement unit wants to use the System in the future after the exhibition. 4. Installation & on site deployment The tenderer shall: - Install all required system software components on site in coordination with the AV integrator contractor (procured separately) and the Procurement unit's team. - Integrate "The Universe" content into existing overhead LED screen and newly purchased hardware. - Conduct full system testing. 5. Training for museum staff The tenderer shall: - Provide training sessions for Procurement unit's staff on System operation, daily use and safety as applicable and needed for the procurement. - Provide training materials (slides, troubleshooting guides, quickstart sheets). 6. Final handover package The tenderer shall provide: - Final approved versions of all media assets. - Backup copies of the System and its configurations. - A complete inventory of all delivered software. - End of project report summarizing methods, design decisions, and technical notes. The procurements requirements are explained in more detail further on in this call for tenders and its attached annexes. The estimated value of the procurement is according to the Procurement unit 400 000 - 550 000 EUR (VAT 0%). Some of the attached annexes in the call for tenders contains confidential information. The documents are available upon request via email to hankinnat@museovirasto.fi. The tenderer shall in its request to receive the documents ensure, that it keeps the information received from the Procurement unit only to itself and uses that information for its tender according to this procurement process. The information is considered confidential even after the procurement process has ended.,

description: Introduction This is a notice of intent, not a request for a quotation. A solicitation document will not be issued, and quotations will not be requested. Purpose The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) intend to negotiate a firm-fixed priced purchase order on a sole source basis with Accruent LLC, located at Domain 3, 11501 Domain Drive, Suite 160, Austin, TX 78758-3598. The purchase order will specifically procure support services for the EMS Software platform for a base year and four option years, as shown below. Further, the support shall include updating the existing EMS Meeting and Room Scheduling Software template in the EMS web client to support hybrid reservations and include the option for either virtual or in-person (hybrid event), to gather requirements for hybrid meetings and conferences, and add additional fields required for audiovisual services to support the events. Base Period: 22 Sep 2026 through 21 Sep 2027 Option Period 1: 22 Sep 2027 through 21 Sep 2028 Option Period 2: 22 Sep 2028 through 21 Sep 2029 Option Period 3: 22 Sep 2029 through 21 Sep 2030 Option Period 4: 22 Sep 2030 through 21 Sep 2031 Authority This acquisition is being conducted under the authority of FAR 12.102 and 41 U.S.C. 1901. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 513210 Software Publishers, with a small business size standard of $47.0 million. Description NIST�s Director�s Office (NISTDO) mission is to promote US innovation and industrial competitiveness by keeping NIST�s numerous operating units advancing measurement science, standards, and technology through research and development in information technology, mathematics, and statistics. NIST has a requirement to have ongoing maintenance and technical support for the EMS Meeting and Room Scheduling Software, which NIST staff use to book available and ideal conference rooms for their meetings and events on the Gaithersburg and Boulder campuses. EMS is an on-premise product, which has been purchased by NIST and is installed and hosted on computers on premise by the NIST Office of Information Systems Management. NIST�s requirement is for ongoing maintenance and technical support. Sole Source Determination The sole source determination is based on the following: Support for NIST�s EMS software licenses is crucial, since it serves as the single source of truth for all campus events, technical setups, and resource coordination. The software offers unique capabilities that are vital to NIST operations. It automatically propagates updates to assignment calendars, preventing scheduling conflicts and costly AV setup errors. Replacing EMS would require abandoning over a decade of system data, custom integrations, and the substantial financial investments recently made to upgrade the system and procure the new digital accessibility module. A transition to any other platform would result in unacceptable project delays, high migration costs, and extensive retraining of agency staff. Accruent, LLC is the sole developer, manufacturer, distributor, and authorized service provider for all EMS Software licensing, maintenance, and technical support. Accruent does not authorize, license, or permit any third-party resellers or service organizations to modify, maintain, or provide technical support for the proprietary EMS code base. Consequently, Accruent is the only source capable of satisfying the government's requirements without causing an immediate lapse in critical software maintenance and technical support. Information for Interested Parties Interested parties that believe they could satisfy the requirements listed above for NIST may clearly and unambiguously identify their capability to do so in writing by or before the response date for this notice. title: Granite Surface Plate
description: This combined synopsis/solicitation has been posting utilizing the Solicitation Module within the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) website at https://piee.eb.mil/. All proposals must be submitted within the Solicitation Module prior to the solicitation closing time. Proposals will not be accepted via email or DoD SAFE. Links to this solicitation and training for the Solicitation Module are listed in the Attachment/Links section of this posting. All solicitation attachments will be posted inside the Solicitation Module. Please monitor the solicitation postings at https://sam.gov and https://piee.eb.mil/ sites for any updates. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.201, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) and DFARS Revolutionary FAR Overhaul Class Deviations (R-DFARS). The RFO regulations are available electronically at the RFO site, https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide. The R-DFARS site are available electronically at https://www.acq.osd.mil/dpap/dars/dfars_far_overhaul_class_deviations.html. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation for which a Request for Quotation (RFQ) will be issued. It is the offerors responsibility to monitor this site for the release of amendments (if any). The RFQ number is FA226326Q0020 and shall be referenced on any offer submitted. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 334516 and the business size standard is 1000 employees. AFMETCAL at Heath OH intends to award one firm fixed price Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract under Simplified Acquisition Procedures (SAP) in accordance with FAR Part 12-Acquisition of Commercial Items, for the purchase of Granite Surface Plates with a 1 year commercial warranty and Commercial Engineering Design Data.Products offered shall be commercial items or commercially available off-the shelf (COTS) items meeting the definitions in FAR Part 2. Items proposed shall be new units. Reconditioned, remanufactured, or used items are not acceptable and shall not be proposed. The unit must meet the requirements of Purchase Description (PD) (Attachment 1) to the RFQ. The RFQ with applicable documents are available for download at Solicitation Module within the PIEE website. Please review ALL documents carefully.IMPORTANT NOTICE TO OFFERORS: All prospective awardees are required to register at SAM and to maintain active registration during the life of the contract. SAM can be accessed at https://www.sam.gov. Offerors must also register for the Solicitation module on the PIEE website (https://piee.eb.mil/) to submit a proposal. Any award resulting from this solicitation will include DFARS Clause 252.232-7003, Electronic Submission of Payment Requests and Receiving Reports. Section 1008 of the National Defense Authorization Act of Fiscal Year 2001 requires any claims for payment (invoices) under DoD contract to be submitted in electronic form. Wide Area WorkFlow (WAWF) through PIEE is the DoD system of choice for implementing this statutory requirement. Use of the basic system is at no cost to the contractor. Contractors must complete vendor training, which is also available at no cost at https://piee.eb.mil/. Prior to submitting invoices in the production system, contractors must register for an account at https://piee.eb.mil/. Offers MUST:(1) be valid for a period of 120 days,(2) be for the item described in the purchase description (List of Attachments, Attachment 1),(3) be for a new unit (not reconditioned, remanufactured, or used unit),(4) be FOB Destination,(5) include a delivery schedule, if unable to meet delivery schedule in Deliveries and Performance section,(6) include copy of commercial price list,(7) include copy of commercial warranty,(8) include name of and be signed by an authorized company representative along with telephone number, facsimile number, and email address,(9) include taxpayer identification number (TIN), CAGE Code Number and DUNS Number,(10) include a technical proposal that includes a written response to each paragraph of the PD,(11) include completed Supplies or Services and Price/Cost section, which includes pricing for Production year quantities, CLINs 0001-0003 only need unit prices added in Supplies/Service column (do not fill out Unit price or Amount column for CLINs 0001-0003),(12) include a completed Total Evaluated Price Worksheet (List of Attachments, Attachment 5),(13) completed Offeror Representations and Certifications ? Commercial Items. Offerors shall ensure information in SAM is current.Offers (including both written proposal and commercial unit submission) must be received no later than 02 September 2026 at 2:00 PM EDT. Offerors shall submit electronic files to Solicitation Module, https://piee.eb.mil/, following the instructions provided in List of Attachments ? Attachment 4 of the RFQ, under Electronic Submission of Proposal paragraph. Offers submitted in forms other than through Solicitation module are not permissible and will not be considered. Please note that the uploaded files must be timestamped by the offer due date and time. Offerors bare the risk for receipt of submitted offers being untimely. Offerors shall allow sufficient time for receipt of electronic submissions by the due date and time. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which if received timely shall be considered by this agency.
