title: San Rafael Creek and ATF FY26 Maintenance Dredging
description: Procurement will be conducted under FSC CODE: Y1KF, NAICS Code: 237990. The size standard for this code is $37,000,000. All questions should be directed to the Contract Specialist, Logan Champlin, logan.champlin@usace.army.mil Estimated Cost Range is between $10,000,000 - $25,000,000. PROJECT TITLE: San Rafael Creek and ATF FY26 Maintenance Dredging Project Location: Marin County, CA. Project Description: The work includes maintenance dredging of the San Rafael Creek Channel to -6-ft (MLLW) plus 1-ft of paid over-depth and the Across the Flats (ATF) channel to -8 ft (MLLW) plus 1-ft of paid over-depth and transporting of the dredged material per the requirements in specification Section 00 10 00 PRICING SCHEDULE and 01 11 00 SUMMARY OF WORK. Material from Reaches 0 and 3 is suitable and shall be taken for disposal at the Government-furnished site SF-10. Material from Reaches 1 and 2 is suitable and shall be taken for disposal at the Government-furnished site SF 11. This requirement is for FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION and will be issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP), Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) which will result in the award of a single Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract. The solicitation will be available on/about 03 August 2026 for viewing/downloading. ALL Proposals will be due on/about 02 September 2026, at 12:00 PM PST. The specific date and time will be identified in the solicitation. OFFERORS ARE ADVISED THIS PROJECT MAY BE DELAYED, CANCELLED, OR REVISED AT ANY TIME DURING THE SOLICITATION, SELECTION, EVALUATION, AND/OR FINAL AWARD PROCESS. Plans and specs will not be provided in hard copy or CD format. NOTE: a) In preparation for prospective to submit offers when the RFP is issued, it is imperative that all prospective Offerors (including their subcontractors) must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM - www.SAM.gov) and the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) website in order to be able to view and download solicitation information, and to submit offers. b) Solicitation documents, plans, and specifications are only available to be download from PIEE, which may be accessed at https://wawf.eb.mil OR https://piee.eb.mil OR https://piee.eb.mil/xhtml/unauth/home/login.xhtml. c) Offers MUST BE submitted electronically through the PIEE website. d) Registration should be completed one (1) week prior to the anticipated solicitation release date. USACE will not notify Offerors of any changes to the solicitation; Offerors must monitor PIEE and SAM for the solicitation to be posted, and for any posted changes or amendments. e) See attachments -PIEE Solicitation Module Vendor Access Instructions-, -SOP PIEE Proposal Manager Offeror-, and -SOP PIEE Posting Offer- for instructions on getting access to the PIEE Solicitation Module and submitting Offeror proposals.

title: Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) BSCA Prospective Payment System Technical Assistance Logical Follow-On (LFO)
description: The Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) BSCA Prospective Payment System Technical Assistance Logical Follow-On (LFO ) will provide Technical Assistance (TA) to states participating in the Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) Demonstration and ensure payments to CCBHCs behavioral health providers are economic and efficient and align with the statutory requirement as outlined under the authorizing section 223 (C) of the 2014 Protecting Access to Medicare Act (PAMA) as extended by section 11001 of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. As part of the technical assistance (TA) on sustaining the CCBHC demonstration under Medicaid state plan, the contractor also hosts additional TA sessions in order to provide guidance to CCBHC demonstration states about the new state plan option that is available under the 2024 Consolidated Appropriations Act, provide additional TA for states that implement the demonstration in a managed care environment, and provide additional training for states to review cost reports that will help protect the demonstration against potential fraud and abuse. The current task order also requires logistical project management support for up to 15 remote technical assistance (TA) sessions in the grantee planning phase of the Demonstration for the 15 Cohort-1 states. The contractor is also required to assist CMS with content review of the revised CMS CCBHC PPS guidance to ensure documentation reflects the required policy refinements. This Logical Follow-on task order will require an additional 12 months of technical support to CMS and to the states. During these months, NORC will continue to field questions from the states, engage in policy and programmatic discussions with CMS and be on hand to support CMS with any needs that arise. It will also allow NORC to review additional cost reports that will be submitted by states during this period. CMS expects 10 current demonstration states, representing approximately 55 clinics, to submit cost reports between the end of June 2026 and September 2026 and the logical follow on will allow NORC to review and track these cost report submissions on behalf of CMS. NORC will also review and track the cost reports of the additional 10 states that will be added to the demonstration in 2026.

title: 2027 Southern Hemisphere Influenza Vaccine
description: The Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support is soliciting for the supply of Southern Hemisphere Influenza Vaccine for the 2027-2028 flu season. Approximately 30,000 doses are included in this requirement. (Quantities may increase or decrease pending receipt of final Service requirements.) The vaccines shall be a pre-measured 0.5 ML dose, each dose shall be pre-filled in a commercially available syringe for intramuscular administration in healthy individuals aged 6 months and older. The vaccine shall be U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA)-approved and U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommended. The formula for the 2027-2028 season vaccine shall be determined by the FDA�s Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee. Other specification data is included in the solicitation. Successful contractor must have FDA Approval and the vaccine must be ACIP recommended. National Stock Numbers shall be established at time of award. An indefinite quantity contract is proposed. The quantity indicated is an annual estimate only. (Quantities may increase or decrease pending receipt of final Service requirements.) The guaranteed minimum will be 75% of the annual estimate, and a contract maximum will be established at 150% of the annual estimate. All quantities shall be delivered to the Defense Depot New Cumberland, PA. The contractor shall be capable of delivering 100% of the requirements by March 12, 2027. This delivery schedule is the preferred delivery schedule. Other delivery schedules will be considered. A copy of the solicitation will be posted to the DLA Bid Board System (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil and SAM.gov at https://www.sam.gov. Interested parties should contact Rosbert Jones (rosbert.jones@dla.mil) for any questions/comments. Interested parties are further advised to set up automated notifications of presolicitation or solicitation changes through this website. The current projected solicitation date is September of 2026. DLA reserves the right to issue the solicitation before or after the projected solicitation date.

title: Germany – Industry specific software development services – MEM - Lehrplaneditor
description: Der Lehrplan-Editor als webbasiertes Content-Management-System (CMS) ermöglicht die Erstellung, Digitalisierung und Pflege der öffentlichen Lehrpläne der 16 Bundesländer (im Bereich der allgemeinbildenden Schulen, Textelementenumfang ca. 5 Mio.) in Deutschland. Ziel ist es, eine einheitliche, strukturierte und zugleich flexible Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen, die den zum Teil sehr unterschiedlichen Anforderungen der Bundesländer gerecht wird. Aktuell liegen die Lehrpläne der 16 Bundesländer vorwiegend als PDF-Dokumente vor, was bedeutet, dass sie nicht maschinenlesbar sind. Der Lehrplan-Editor speichert sämtliche maschinenlesbaren Lehrplan-Daten in der im MEM-Projekt erstellten RDF-Datenbank (triple store) ab. Zusätzlich ermöglicht die Export-Funktion des Lehrplan-Editors es, die Lehrpläne u.a. im PDF-Format zu erstellen.
